name: webdatatools-mcp-server
description: Web search, article extraction, site crawling, contact & tech-stack detection, company profiling, e-mail/DNS security and package health as MCP tools. Uses your own Apify API token — billed to you, not us.
long_description:
WebDataTools exposes ten of WebDataTools' Apify Actors as MCP tools: web search and URL reading, full-site Markdown crawling, contact/social extraction, tech-stack fingerprinting, a one-stop company profile, e-mail/DNS security scoring, bulk e-mail validation, npm/PyPI/Crates.io package health, and raw Google SERP data.

Every tool call runs on your own Apify account (get a free token with $5/month credit at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations), so usage is billed to you, never to the server author.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: Your personal Apify API token. Get a free one (with $5/month free credit) at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Every tool call is billed to this account, never to the server author.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and get back clean Markdown of the top results (or read specific URLs directly, skipping search). Good default choice for 'what is X' / 'find info about X' questions. Each result page fetched is a billed row.

query.description: A single search query, e.g. 'best crm for startups'. Ignored if `queries` or `urls` is set.

queries.description: Multiple search queries to run in one call. Overrides `query` when non-empty.

urls.description: Specific page URLs to fetch and convert to Markdown directly, skipping the Google search step.

maxResults.description: How many organic results to read per query.

outputFormat.description: Body format to return for each result.

includeSnippetOnly.description: If true, return only the SERP title/url/snippet without fetching the page (faster, cheaper).

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch one or more article/blog/news URLs and return clean, readable article text as Markdown (title, author, date, body). Use this instead of web_search when you already have the exact URL to read.

url.description: A single article URL to extract, e.g. https://blog.apify.com/some-post/.

urls.description: Multiple article URLs to extract in one call. Overrides `url` when non-empty.

outputFormat.description: Which body format(s) to return. Markdown is smallest and best for LLM use.

includeImages.description: Include the main image and image list; turn off for a smaller, text-only result.

tools.name: crawl_site_markdown
tools.description: Crawl a website starting from one URL and return one Markdown document per page (docs sites, blogs, knowledge bases). Billed per page crawled, so keep `maxPages` as low as the task allows.

url.description: The page to start crawling from, e.g. https://docs.apify.com/platform.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl and convert. This is the billed unit — raise only as needed.

maxDepth.description: How many links deep to follow from the start URL.

sameDomainOnly.description: Only follow links on the same domain as the start URL.

useSitemap.description: Also seed the crawl from the domain's sitemap.xml.

outputFormat.description: Content format to return per page.

tools.name: extract_contacts
tools.description: Crawl a website's home/about/contact pages and pull out e-mail addresses, phone numbers and social profile links (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub, Telegram, WhatsApp).

url.description: A single website to crawl, e.g. https://example.com or example.com.

urls.description: Multiple websites to crawl in one call (one result row per site). Overrides `url` when non-empty.

maxPagesPerDomain.description: How many pages to crawl per website.

maxDepth.description: How many links deep to follow from the start page.

followSubdomains.description: Also crawl subdomains such as blog.example.com.

extractPhones.description: Collect phone numbers (from tel: links only).

tools.name: detect_tech_stack
tools.description: Fingerprint a website's technology stack: CMS, e-commerce platform, analytics, ad pixels, e-mail marketing, chat widgets, payment providers, front-end frameworks, cookie consent, CDN/hosting and web server.

url.description: A single website to fingerprint, e.g. https://example.com or example.com.

urls.description: Multiple websites to fingerprint in one call (one result row per site). Overrides `url` when non-empty.

categories.description: Restrict detection to these categories. Leave empty to detect everything.

maxPagesPerDomain.description: How many pages to fetch per website.

followSubdomains.description: Also inspect subdomains such as shop.example.com.

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Build a one-stop company profile for a domain: contacts, tech stack, DNS/e-mail security, TLS/security grade, hiring signals, Wikidata company facts (HQ, employees, revenue, founders) and an SEO audit. Turn off sections you don't need to make the run cheaper and faster.

domain.description: A single company domain, e.g. apify.com.

domains.description: Multiple company domains (one result row per domain). Overrides `domain` when non-empty.

includeContacts.description: Include e-mails, phone numbers and social links.

includeEmailSecurity.description: Include SPF/DMARC, mail provider, registrar, domain age.

includeSecurityAudit.description: Include TLS validity/expiry and HTTP security header grade.

includeHiring.description: Include open job counts / hiring velocity where an ATS board is found.

includeCompanyFacts.description: Include Wikidata facts: HQ, employees, revenue, founders.

includeSeo.description: Include a 0-100 on-page SEO score and issue list for the home page.

tools.name: check_email_security
tools.description: Check a domain's DNS and e-mail security posture: SPF, DMARC, DKIM selector presence, mail/DNS provider, registrar and domain age, with an overall 0-100 score.

domain.description: A single domain to check, e.g. apify.com.

domains.description: Multiple domains to check in one call (one result row per domain). Overrides `domain` when non-empty.

checkDkim.description: Probe common DKIM selectors. Costs extra DNS queries per domain but is needed for a full score.

tools.name: validate_emails
tools.description: Validate a list of e-mail addresses: syntax check, disposable/role-account detection and (optionally) a live MX/A DNS lookup to confirm the domain can receive mail. Good for cleaning a lead list before sending.

email.description: A single e-mail address to validate.

emails.description: Multiple e-mail addresses to validate in one call. Overrides `email` when non-empty.

checkMx.description: Look up MX/A records over DNS-over-HTTPS. Turn off for a faster syntax-only check.

tools.name: package_health
tools.description: Check the health of npm, PyPI or Crates.io packages: latest version, publish recency, download stats, license, and (optionally) GitHub stars/forks/open-issues/archived status. Prefix a name with its registry, e.g. pypi:requests.

package.description: A single package to check, e.g. npm:react or pypi:requests.

packages.description: Multiple packages to check in one call. Overrides `package` when non-empty.

defaultRegistry.description: Registry to assume for bare package names with no prefix.

enrichGithub.description: Add GitHub stars/forks/open-issues/archived/last-push when the package links to a GitHub repo.

tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Run a raw Google search and get back structured SERP data: organic results, People Also Ask, related searches. Use this when you need Google's ranking/position data itself, not just page content (for that, use web_search).

query.description: A single Google search query, e.g. 'apify web scraping'.

queries.description: Multiple queries to run in one call. Overrides `query` when non-empty.

maxPagesPerQuery.description: How many result pages to fetch per query.

includePeopleAlsoAsk.description: Include the People Also Ask box.
